question: What is the primary objective of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015?
options: To stop all trading in shares
To prevent trading based on Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI)
To allow directors to make more money
answer: To prevent trading based on Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI)
explanation: इन regulations का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि UPSI होने पर कोई भी व्यक्ति securities में trade न करे, जिससे सभी investors के लिए एक समान अवसर (level playing field) सुनिश्चित हो सके।

question: Who is considered an 'Insider' under these regulations?
options: A Connected Person or anyone in possession of UPSI
answer: A Connected Person or anyone in possession of UPSI
hint: Access (पहुंच) insider status निर्धारित करती है।
explanation: एक insider को व्यापक रूप से 'Connected Person' या ऐसे किसी भी व्यक्ति के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है जिसके पास UPSI है या उस तक पहुँच (access) है।

question: What does 'UPSI' stand for?
answer: Unpublished Price Sensitive Information
explanation: UPSI उस जानकारी को संदर्भित करता है जो आम तौर पर उपलब्ध (generally available) नहीं होती है, लेकिन यदि उपलब्ध हो, तो securities की कीमत (price) को भौतिक (materially) रूप से प्रभावित करेगी।

question: Which of the following constitutes UPSI?
answer: Declaration of dividends
hint: Corporate action जो अभी public नहीं हुई है।
explanation: Financial results, dividends, mergers, या capital structure में बदलाव जैसी जानकारी तब तक UPSI होती है जब तक कि उसे सार्वजनिक (public) न कर दिया जाए।

question: A 'Connected Person' is someone associated with the company during the ________ prior to the act.
answer: 6 months
explanation: यदि कोई व्यक्ति किसी कार्य से पहले के छह महीनों (six months) के दौरान किसी भी क्षमता (capacity) में कंपनी से जुड़ा था, तो उसे connected माना जाता है।

question: Is it legal to communicate UPSI to someone else?
options: No, unless it is for a legitimate purpose
Yes, if they are your family
answer: No, unless it is for a legitimate purpose
hint: Need to know basis (आवश्यकता के आधार पर)।
explanation: UPSI का संचार (communication) निषिद्ध (prohibited) है जब तक कि यह वैध उद्देश्यों (legitimate purposes), कर्तव्यों के प्रदर्शन (performance of duties), या कानूनी दायित्वों (legal obligations) के निर्वहन (discharge) के लिए न हो।

question: What is the 'Trading Window'?
options: A physical window in the stock exchange
The period during which trading is permitted for designated persons
The time when the market is closed
answer: The period during which trading is permitted for designated persons
hint: Trading के लिए हरी झंडी (Green light)।
explanation: Trading Window वह विशिष्ट अवधि (specific period) है जब Designated Persons trade कर सकते हैं; जब यह 'बंद' (closed) होती है, तो वे trade नहीं कर सकते।

question: When must the Trading Window be closed?
options: When the Compliance Officer determines a Designated Person has UPSI
answer: When the Compliance Officer determines a Designated Person has UPSI
explanation: Window तब बंद कर दी जाती है जब compliance officer यह निर्धारित करता है कि designated persons के पास UPSI (जैसे, financial results से पहले) होने की उम्मीद (expectation) है।

question: The Trading Window typically closes for financial results from:
options: The day of the Board Meeting
The end of the quarter until 48 hours after declaration
answer: The end of the quarter until 48 hours after declaration
hint: Quarter end से public release तक।
explanation: Standard practice यह है कि window को हर quarter के अंत (end) से results सार्वजनिक (public) होने के 48 घंटे बाद तक बंद रखा जाता है।

question: What is 'Pre-clearance of Trades'?
options: Getting prior approval from the Compliance Officer for trades above a threshold
answer: Getting prior approval from the Compliance Officer for trades above a threshold
explanation: यदि प्रस्तावित (proposed) trade की value एक निर्धारित सीमा (stipulated threshold) से अधिक है, तो Designated persons को Compliance Officer से पूर्व अनुमोदन (prior approval / pre-clearance) प्राप्त करना होगा।

question: Once pre-clearance is granted, the trade must be executed within:
answer: 7 trading days
explanation: यदि approval के बाद 7 trading days के भीतर trade execute नहीं किया जाता है, तो pre-clearance समाप्त (expires) हो जाता है।

question: Who is responsible for formulating the 'Code of Fair Disclosure'?
options: The Board of Directors of the listed company
answer: The Board of Directors of the listed company
explanation: Board of Directors को UPSI के fair disclosure (निष्पक्ष प्रकटीकरण) के लिए practices और procedures का एक code formulate और publish करना चाहिए।

question: A 'Trading Plan' allows an insider to:
options: Trade while in possession of UPSI legally
answer: Trade while in possession of UPSI legally
explanation: एक insider एक trading plan बना सकता है और उसे Compliance Officer के सामने पेश कर सकता है ताकि वह compliant manner (अनुपालन तरीके) से trade कर सके, भले ही बाद में उसके पास UPSI हो।

question: The cool-off period for a Trading Plan (time between submission and start of trading) is:
answer: 6 months
explanation: Trading plan के सार्वजनिक प्रकटीकरण (public disclosure) से छह महीने (six months) से पहले trading शुरू नहीं हो सकती है।

question: Is a 'Deemed Connected Person' liable for insider trading?
options: Yes, they are treated the same as connected persons
Only if they sign a contract
answer: Yes, they are treated the same as connected persons
explanation: Deemed connected persons (जैसे immediate relatives, bankers, auditors) को UPSI तक पहुंच (access) रखने वाला माना जाता है और वे उत्तरदायी (liable) होते हैं।

question: If a Compliance Officer wants to trade, who approves their pre-clearance?
options: The Board of Directors or Audit Committee Chairman
answer: The Board of Directors or Audit Committee Chairman
hint: अपने स्वयं के trade को approve नहीं कर सकते।
explanation: Conflict of interest से बचने के लिए, CO के trades को Board या Audit Committee Head द्वारा approve किया जाता है।

question: Initial Disclosure of holdings must be made by a promoter/director/KMP within _______ of appointment.
answer: 7 days
explanation: Appointment (नियुक्ति) पर या promoter बनने पर, व्यक्ति को 7 दिनों के भीतर अपनी holding का disclose (प्रकटीकरण) करना होगा।

question: Which of these is NOT considered 'Generally Available Information'?
options: Information listed on the Stock Exchange
Information discussed in a private board meeting
answer: Information discussed in a private board meeting
explanation: एक private meeting की जानकारी गैर-भेदभावपूर्ण (non-discriminatory) आधार पर public के लिए सुलभ (accessible) नहीं होती है, इसलिए यह UPSI है।

question: Continual Disclosure is triggered if the value of traded securities exceeds:
options: Rs. 10 Lakhs in a calendar quarter
answer: Rs. 10 Lakhs in a calendar quarter
explanation: यदि किसी calendar quarter (कैलेंडर तिमाही) में trades (buy या sell) का मूल्य (value) Rs. 10 Lakhs से अधिक हो जाता है, तो disclosure अनिवार्य (mandatory) है।

question: Who acts as the 'Chief Investor Relations Officer' (CIRO)?
options: An officer designated to deal with dissemination of information and disclosure of UPSI
answer: An officer designated to deal with dissemination of information and disclosure of UPSI
explanation: CIRO यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए ज़िम्मेदार (responsible) है कि UPSI को public/analysts के साथ निष्पक्ष (fairly) और समान (uniformly) रूप से साझा किया जाए।

question: What is a 'Contra Trade'?
options: Reversing a transaction (e.g., Selling shortly after Buying)
answer: Reversing a transaction (e.g., Selling shortly after Buying)
explanation: Contra trade में 6 महीने के भीतर एक opposite transaction (खरीदने के बाद बेचना या इसके विपरीत) execute करना शामिल है।

question: Designated Persons are prohibited from executing a Contra Trade for:
answer: 6 months
explanation: Insiders द्वारा short-term speculation (सट्टेबाजी) को रोकने के लिए, contra trades पर 6 महीने (6 months) का प्रतिबंध (ban) है।

question: The 'Chinese Wall' policy separates:
options: Departments with UPSI (Inside areas) from public areas
answer: Departments with UPSI (Inside areas) from public areas
explanation: Chinese Walls 'Inside Areas' (जैसे Investment Banking) से 'Public Areas' (जैसे Sales/Marketing) में UPSI के प्रवाह (flow) को रोकती हैं।

question: Bringing an employee 'Over the Wall' means:
options: Sharing UPSI with them for a specific, legitimate purpose
answer: Sharing UPSI with them for a specific, legitimate purpose
explanation: यह आवश्यकता के आधार (need-to-know basis) पर एक specific transaction के लिए public-side employee को UPSI तक पहुंच (access) देने को संदर्भित करता है।

question: Generally Available Information means information that is accessible to the public on a:
answer: Non-discriminatory basis
hint: हर किसी को समान रूप से उपलब्ध (Available to everyone equally)।
explanation: यदि जानकारी बिना किसी भेदभाव (discrimination) के सभी के लिए उपलब्ध है (जैसे, exchange website पर), तो यह generally available है।

question: Which regulation governs the 'informant' (Whistleblower) mechanism for insider trading?
answer: SEBI (PIT) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2019
explanation: इस amendment ने उन informants के लिए एक इनाम तंत्र (reward mechanism) पेश किया जो SEBI को insider trading की report करते हैं।

question: Can an insider prove their innocence?
options: Yes, by demonstrating the trade was an off-market transfer between insiders with the same UPSI
answer: Yes, by demonstrating the trade was an off-market transfer between insiders with the same UPSI
explanation: Regulations विशिष्ट बचाव (specific defenses) प्रदान करते हैं, जैसे insiders के बीच off-market inter-se transfers जहाँ दोनों parties के पास समान UPSI था।

question: What is the penalty for Insider Trading under the SEBI Act?
options: Rs. 25 Crores or 3 times the profit, whichever is higher
answer: Rs. 25 Crores or 3 times the profit, whichever is higher
explanation: Insider trading SEBI Act के तहत monetary penalties के उच्चतम स्तर (highest tier) को आकर्षित (attracts) करता है।

question: Are 'Immediate Relatives' considered Connected Persons?
options: Yes, if they are financially dependent or consult the insider for trading decisions
Only if they work in the same company
answer: Yes, if they are financially dependent or consult the insider for trading decisions
explanation: Immediate relatives को connected माना जाता है यदि वे आर्थिक (financially) रूप से insider पर निर्भर हैं या trading के लिए उनसे परामर्श (consult) करते हैं।

question: A Trading Plan, once approved:
answer: Is irrevocable
explanation: एक बार approved हो जाने के बाद, insider को plan के अनुसार trades execute *करना ही होगा*; वे इसे cancel या इससे विचलित (deviate) नहीं हो सकते।

question: Structured Digital Database (SDD) must be maintained to record:
options: Details of persons with whom UPSI is shared
answer: Details of persons with whom UPSI is shared
explanation: कंपनियों को एक audit trail बनाने के लिए प्रत्येक उस व्यक्ति का digital database (time stamps के साथ) बनाए रखना चाहिए जिसे UPSI प्राप्त होता है।

question: The 'Compliance Officer' for PIT regulations is usually:
options: The Company Secretary or a Senior Officer
answer: The Company Secretary or a Senior Officer
explanation: CO आमतौर पर Company Secretary या Board को report करने वाला एक senior officer होता है।

question: Legitimate Purpose for sharing UPSI includes sharing with:
options: Partners, auditors, lenders, legal advisors in the ordinary course of business
answer: Partners, auditors, lenders, legal advisors in the ordinary course of business
explanation: Business operations के लिए advisors या lenders के साथ जानकारी साझा करना एक legitimate purpose (वैध उद्देश्य) माना जाता है।

question: If a Designated Person resigns, how long are they still considered to have access to UPSI?
options: Usually for a cooling-off period (e.g., 6 months)
answer: Usually for a cooling-off period (e.g., 6 months)
explanation: वे नौकरी छोड़ने के बाद एक अवधि (अक्सर 6 महीने) के लिए code of conduct के अधीन (subject) रहते हैं, क्योंकि UPSI अभी भी ताज़ा (fresh) हो सकता है।

question: Trading Window restrictions apply to:
options: Designated Persons and their immediate relatives
answer: Designated Persons and their immediate relatives
explanation: प्रतिबंध (restrictions) उन लोगों पर लागू होते हैं जिन्हें 'Designated Persons' के रूप में पहचाना जाता है जिनके पास UPSI होने की संभावना है।

question: Can SEBI investigate a trust or a partnership firm for Insider Trading?
options: Yes, 'Person' includes companies, firms, and trusts
answer: Yes, 'Person' includes companies, firms, and trusts
explanation: Regulations में 'Person' की परिभाषा व्यापक है और इसमें सभी legal entities शामिल हैं।

question: What is 'tipping' in the context of insider trading?
options: Passing UPSI to another person who then trades
answer: Passing UPSI to another person who then trades
explanation: Tipping एक insider द्वारा किसी outsider (tippee) को UPSI प्रदान करने का कार्य है जो फिर उस जानकारी के आधार पर trade करता है।

question: If a Compliance Officer refuses pre-clearance, can the employee trade?
options: Yes, if they pay a fine
answer: No, they must not trade
explanation: Pre-clearance के बिना या उसके खिलाफ trading करना Code of Conduct का उल्लंघन (violation) है।

question: Disclosure of 'Off-market' trades by insiders must be reported to the exchange within:
answer: 2 trading days
explanation: Off-market trades को 2 working days के भीतर कंपनी को report किया जाना चाहिए, और कंपनी exchange को सूचित (notifies) करती है।

question: Which form is used for 'Continual Disclosure'?
answer: Form C
explanation: Form C designated persons द्वारा trades के continual disclosure के लिए standard format है।

question: The 'Model Code of Conduct' is specified in which Schedule?
answer: Schedule B
explanation: Schedule B Listed Companies के लिए Code of Conduct के Minimum Standards की रूपरेखा (outlines) तैयार करता है।

question: If an insider trades on UPSI but loses money, is it still an offense?
options: No, because there was no profit
Yes, trading while in possession of UPSI is the offense
Only if the loss is small
answer: Yes, trading while in possession of UPSI is the offense
explanation: अपराध (offense) एक अनुचित लाभ (unfair advantage - UPSI) होने पर trading करने का कार्य है; profit या loss उल्लंघन के लिए अप्रासंगिक (irrelevant) है।

question: Can a 'Director' simply say they didn't know the rules?
options: Yes, ignorance is a valid excuse
No, ignorance of law is no excuse
answer: No, ignorance of law is no excuse
explanation: Directors और key personnel से regulations को जानने और उनका पालन करने (abide) की अपेक्षा (expected) की जाती है।

question: Material Event disclosure must be made to Stock Exchanges:
options: As soon as reasonably possible and not later than 24 hours
answer: As soon as reasonably possible and not later than 24 hours
explanation: LODR (UPSI से जुड़ा) के तहत, material events का तुरंत (24 घंटे के भीतर) खुलासा (disclosed) किया जाना चाहिए।

question: The burden of proof to show they did not have UPSI lies on:
answer: The Connected Person
hint: जब तक निर्दोष साबित न हो (connected persons के लिए)।
explanation: Connected persons के मामले में, यह साबित करने की ज़िम्मेदारी (onus) उन पर होती है कि उनके पास UPSI *नहीं* था।

question: Does the PIT Regulation apply to unlisted companies?
options: Yes, if they are filing for an IPO (proposed to be listed)
answer: Yes, if they are filing for an IPO (proposed to be listed)
hint: List होने का इरादा (Intending to list)।
explanation: Regulations उन कंपनियों पर लागू होते हैं जिनकी securities listed हैं या list होने का प्रस्ताव (proposed) है।

question: What happens if a Trading Plan violates the Trading Window norms?
options: The Plan prevails (Trading Window norms don't apply to approved Plans)
answer: The Plan prevails (Trading Window norms don't apply to approved Plans)
explanation: Approved Trading Plan के अनुसार execute किए गए trades को सामान्य Trading Window restrictions से छूट (exempt) दी जाती है।

question: Who must approve the 'List of Designated Persons'?
options: The Compliance Officer in consultation with the Board/MD
answer: The Compliance Officer in consultation with the Board/MD
explanation: Management यह तय करता है कि UPSI तक किसकी पहुंच (access) है और उन्हें तदनुसार (accordingly) designate (नामित) करता है।

question: Are 'Mutual Funds' dealing in the company shares considered insiders?
options: Yes, if they possess UPSI about the company
answer: Yes, if they possess UPSI about the company
explanation: कोई भी entity, जिसमें Mutual Fund भी शामिल है, एक insider बन जाती है यदि उनके पास UPSI है।

question: The Reward for an informant can be up to:
answer: Rs. 10 Crores
explanation: SEBI एक informant को Rs. 10 Crores तक का इनाम (reward) दे सकता है, जिसकी टिप से disgorged amounts की recovery होती है।
